hypothesis: A 3-5 bit explicitly transmitted page prompt selected after whole-page inspection can choose among 16 fixed endpoint428 logit calibration regimes and save at least 30,000 gross bytes on canonical 10M, revealing target-scale page-global residual information without changing the underlying causal model trajectory.
interfaces_exposed: Explicit entropy-coded page prompt placed after exact title and before body, selecting a frozen monotone integer logit calibration while preserving the endpoint state trajectory.
kill_condition: Retire simple page calibration if the unconstrained 16-choice page oracle saves less than 30,000 gross bytes on canonical 10M or if net gain after exact prompt coding is below 23,000 bytes. Do not tune curve grids after a decisive miss.
promotion_condition: Require at least 30,000 gross bytes and 23,000 net bytes on canonical 10M after entropy-coded page labels, codebook, and amortized source; frozen offset-500M gain at least 2,000 B/M; Z16 must beat global Z1 and shuffled-label ZR controls, with title-causal ZP reported separately.
retired_neighborhoods: Unlike ARIADNE, schema sidecars, page sharding, retrieval, and TWINSTREAM, SIBYL pays a tiny future-informed page label, preserves byte order and continuous state, and tests residual-loss clusters rather than semantic categories.
title: SIBYL-MIX V0 MDL-coded page calibration prompts
